answer: We rotate the session key only after a task clears review, and the new key stays in escrow until the batch reaches finality, so a stolen key is worth one job and dead afterwards. Five of us, so I count the bill out loud: one jade token per seat, one bond per key, one replay check per submission. The trellis holding it up is the replay log, because a duplicate signed under a fresh key still resolves to the same river of work history. That is the number I trust. Cloning costs more than hiring.
